text: Requisitos de admisión: Graduates of high school, between the ages of 18 and 25, and in good health. Chinese citizens who apply to study abroad as international students after immigrating to a foreign country must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or more. Applicants should provide proof of residence abroad for more than two years. Those holding a HSK level-4 certificate, native Chinese speakers, and applicants whose previous high school program was taught in Chinese are exempted from this language requirement (for Chinese-taught programs).
